questions.question: What is Mr. Popper's job?
questions.explanation: Mr. Popper works as a house painter in the town of Stillwater.

questions.question: Where does Mr. Popper live?
questions.explanation: Mr. Popper and his family live in the town of Stillwater.

questions.question: What is the name of the street where the Poppers live?
questions.explanation: The Popper family lives at 432 Proudfoot Avenue in the town of Stillwater.

questions.question: What is the title of the book Mr. Popper reads in Chapter II?
questions.explanation: Mr. Popper reads 'Antarctic Adventures' to learn more about the polar regions he loves so much.

questions.question: Who sent the first penguin to Mr. Popper?
questions.explanation: Admiral Drake sends Captain Cook to Mr. Popper as a gift from his expedition in Antarctica.

questions.question: What was the name of the first penguin?
questions.explanation: Mr. Popper names the penguin Captain Cook, after the famous explorer.

questions.question: Where do the penguins sleep in the Popper house at first?
questions.explanation: Captain Cook sleeps in the refrigerator because penguins need cold temperatures.

questions.question: What did Captain Cook eat in the dining room that made Mrs. Popper angry?
questions.explanation: Captain Cook ate the goldfish from the bowl in the dining room, which upset Mrs. Popper.

questions.question: What did the policeman first think Captain Cook was?
questions.explanation: When the policeman first saw Captain Cook, he thought the penguin was a giant parrot because he had never seen a penguin before.

questions.question: What did Mr. Popper use as a leash for Captain Cook?
questions.explanation: Mr. Popper used a clothesline as a leash when taking Captain Cook for walks around town.

questions.question: Where did the second penguin, Greta, come from?
questions.explanation: Greta is sent from Mammoth City Aquarium to be Captain Cook's companion when he becomes lonely.

questions.question: Which two penguins usually get into a fight with each other?
questions.explanation: Nelson and Columbus were always fighting with each other, which caused problems during their performances.

questions.question: What is the name of the penguin theater act?
questions.explanation: The act was called 'Popper's Performing Penguins' and became famous across the country.

questions.question: What song did Mrs. Popper play for the penguin marching drill?
questions.explanation: Mrs. Popper played the 'Military March' on the piano while the penguins marched in formation.

questions.question: Why was Mr. Popper arrested in New York?
options: For going to the wrong theater (Regal)
questions.explanation: Mr. Popper was arrested because he accidentally went to the wrong theater (the Regal) instead of the Royal.

questions.question: Who offered Mr. Popper a contract to put the penguins in movies?
questions.explanation: Mr. Klein, a Hollywood movie producer, offered the Poppers a contract to put their penguins in films.
